known_limitations: Initial source-backed batch, not a complete all-time database.
The three American regional Nova competitions are custom game competitions mapped to real-world reference competitions; their formats and founding years remain Nova-specific.
TAS is user-created and has no real-world equivalent. Its user-defined 2027 career scenario is not an official historical result.
Caribbean Cup 2023-2025 does not automatically absorb the predecessor CFU Club Championship.
Season-by-season match results, exact dates, venues, lineups, scorers, assists, cards, attendance, awards and top scorers remain incomplete unless included in an edition record.
Fictional club and player alias maps remain empty until verified matches with existing in-game identities.

Concacaf Champions Cup: champion-only seasons have been expanded from the official 2026 record-holders list; runners-up, finals, exact dates, scorers and seasons not explicitly listed remain unverified.

UEFA Conference League 2025/26: the 153 competition-proper match results are loaded; qualifying rounds, individual goal events for every match and complete per-player statistics remain outside this archive.
